reviewOutcome: Official Stadt Krefeld ALKIS WFS/WMS services were verified anonymously, including a bounded full parcel GML response and an exact-point WMS identity response. Runtime qualification remains held pending serial review and safe GML geometry handling.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: Separate English and German discovery queries were executed and recorded in the city record. WMS capabilities, WFS capabilities, a bounded GML parcel request, exact-point WMS GetFeatureInfo, a failed direct GeoJSON request, and an unavailable official ZIP link were attempted and recorded with statuses and outcomes.
cityOrLocalCustodian: Stadt Krefeld, Fachbereich Vermessung, Kataster und Liegenschaften is evidenced as local publisher/custodian in official city/catalog records. KRZN is the public service host. This is local cadastral-service evidence, not merely national agency prose.
schemaAndCrs: WFS 2.0.0 feature type gis:skre_alkis_adv_flurstueck; native/default CRS EPSG:25832; EPSG:4326 is advertised as an alternate. Native observed fields include OID, IDFLURST, FLSTKENNZ, and FLAECHE. WMS capabilities exposed Liegenschaftskarte and AngabenZumFlurstueck layers.
uncertainty: The WFS returned one full polygon in GML 3.2.1, but the direct application/geo+json request failed with a service geometry conversion exception. The ZIP link returned 503. These are route/output limitations, not evidence of citywide absence. Exact coordinates were preserved and no point-shifting inference was made.
integrationDisposition: Research packet only; not source integration or admission. Only city-389-krefeld.json and krefeld-service-review.json were written in the cohort directory; no registry/catalog/runtime files were changed.
